publicReleaseNotes: Lamp 1.9.0 builds on Run Edit Run Managed hosting again and records who deletes components. It pins rer 0.2.69 with no local patch to rer: 1.8.1 patched its rer to offer your identity providers on the sign-in page, and Run Edit Run's trusted build refuses a patched rer, so a new Managed installation of 1.8.1 could not be built. rer 0.2.69 offers those sign-in choices itself, and the sign-in page works as before. Deleting a component or a component group, one at a time or in a bulk catalogue edit, now writes one audit entry naming the operator, in the same write as the deletion, so the audit log in Settings lists every deletion with its actor and time, filtered and in CSV. After a Statuspage dry run or import, Cutover lists how operating Lamp differs from Statuspage: a published update is fixed with a correction update rather than edited, component states change with each update you publish, and components set to show only while degraded keep that setting. Cutover also says which Statuspage parts Lamp does not take over yet: Statuspage-format webhook bodies and per-component automation email addresses. No migration applies and no configuration changes; back up first and run rer deploy as before. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/lamp-1.7.0-status-page-1440.png
agentUpdateInstructions: Back up data and owner source first: node scripts/export.mjs --remote with the deployment's --env-file, plus Settings → Export page data. Update the checkout to v1.9.0 and run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; the checkout now pins rer 0.2.69 and carries no patches/ directory or pnpm patchedDependencies entry, so remove any local rer patch your fork kept for the sign-in page's identity providers. Then run rer deploy with the same environment and input file (add --owner-name when it asks without a terminal). No migration applies and no input changes. On Run Edit Run Managed hosting, back up and restore with node scripts/export.mjs and node scripts/import.mjs as OPERATIONS.md describes. Run rer verify and pnpm run validate:release before adopting.
